say:0:1711164001:1.text: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.
say:0:1711164001:1.source_cn: 你的魔力在她的瞳孔深处触碰到了一种绝对不可逆的魔法禁制...
say:0:1711164001:1.male: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.
say:0:1711164001:1.female: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.

say:1:1711164002:1.text: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.
say:1:1711164002:1.source_cn: 逆转现实需要代价，这份代价无法再度被逆转。这是禁术的底...
say:1:1711164002:1.male: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.
say:1:1711164002:1.female: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.

say:2:1711164003:1.text: And so, bound by the rules upon which the spell itself was built, the final price Gwendolyn must pay is:
say:2:1711164003:1.source_cn: 所以，基于逆转魔法底层规则的限制，莫德琳承担的最终代价是——

say:3:1711164004:1.text: In time, she will become <style="highlight">completely blind</style>.

say:5:1711164005:1.text: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.
say:5:1711164005:1.source_cn: 不用……再为我白费力气了。我早就准备好了……接受这一切。
say:5:1711164005:1.male: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.
say:5:1711164005:1.female: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.

say:6:1711164006:1.text: I accepted this possibility long ago. At least, I can still see a little for now. I only hope this lasts long enough for me to see Maximilian and Peggy smile one more time.
say:6:1711164006:1.source_cn: 至少，目前我仍残留着模糊的视觉……希望这点余光，能让我...

say:6:1711164006:1.female: I accepted this possibility long ago. At least, I can still see a little for now. I only hope this lasts long enough for me to see Maximilian and Peggy smile one more time.
